description: Reconcile annualised BF hot-metal output against chosen annual anchor or candidate envelope
required_inputs: BF flow totals; annual anchor; translation assumptions
failure_interpretation: BF route envelope or translation assumptions are inconsistent with the annual target

description: Reconcile annualised DRP DRI output against chosen annual anchor or candidate envelope
required_inputs: DRP flow totals; annual anchor; translation assumptions
failure_interpretation: DRP envelope or availability assumptions are inconsistent with the annual target

description: Reconcile annualised BOF liquid-steel output against the selected route-share anchor
required_inputs: BOF liquid steel totals; route targets
failure_interpretation: BOF route mix or upstream iron supply is inconsistent

description: Reconcile annualised EAF liquid-steel output against the selected route-share anchor
required_inputs: EAF liquid steel totals; route targets
failure_interpretation: EAF route envelope or metallic-feed assumptions are inconsistent

description: Reconcile aggregate finished output or slab-plus-flat output against the chosen production target
required_inputs: downstream sink totals; production target; route outputs
failure_interpretation: Downstream route or sink logic fails to satisfy the target representation
notes: Can be implemented with coarse sinks initially.

description: Check whether BOF and EAF route shares match the active candidate range or scenario choice
required_inputs: BOF totals; EAF totals; route-share target
failure_interpretation: Route split is inconsistent with the chosen configuration or scenario flag
notes: Useful before any market layer is added.

description: Check that DRI inventory end state is neutral or explicitly within the allowed terminal band
required_inputs: initial DRI inventory; final DRI inventory; terminal policy
failure_interpretation: The model is creating value by shifting DRI inventory across the horizon
notes: Covers CDRI or other DRI-like stores if present.

description: Check that slab or WIP end state is neutral or within the allowed terminal band
required_inputs: initial slab WIP state; final slab WIP state; terminal policy
failure_interpretation: The model is using slab or WIP as a free battery or hidden slack

description: Check for costless or repeated DRI charge discharge cycling that creates artificial flexibility
required_inputs: DRI inflow outflow trajectories; inventory trajectory
failure_interpretation: DRI buffer modelling is allowing fake arbitrage

description: Check for costless or repeated slab or WIP cycling that creates artificial flexibility
required_inputs: slab or WIP inflow outflow trajectories; inventory trajectory
failure_interpretation: Slab or WIP treatment is manufacturing flexibility from missing constraints

description: Check whether DSP WBW or cast-split sink assumptions become the binding bottleneck
failure_interpretation: Downstream sink configuration is driving infeasibility or hidden route distortion

description: Classify infeasibility due to inadequate iron units reaching BOF or EAF
failure_interpretation: Iron-unit supply is insufficient for the chosen production target

description: Classify infeasibility due to BOF metallic-mix limits
required_inputs: BOF hot-metal scrap limits; flow diagnostics
failure_interpretation: BOF mix assumptions are too tight or inconsistent

description: Classify infeasibility due to insufficient DRI scrap or other metallic feed for EAF
required_inputs: EAF feed constraints; DRI and scrap availability diagnostics
failure_interpretation: EAF metallic-feed assumptions are inconsistent or too restrictive

description: Classify infeasibility due to downstream sink or routing bottlenecks
required_inputs: cast split; DSP; WBW or sink limits
failure_interpretation: Downstream routing or sink assumptions are too tight

description: Classify infeasibility due to terminal inventory requirements not being satisfiable
failure_interpretation: Endpoint-neutrality requirements conflict with the chosen route or target policy
